subject: Post-call recap & POC setup plan — Acumen Health Tech
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acumenhealth.com>, Jonah Price <jonah.price@acumenhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & POC setup plan — Acumen Health Tech

Hi Sarah / Jonah —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap so we’re aligned and can get the POC kicked off next week. I captured the scope, success metrics, owners, and the immediate setup items below. Please confirm or add anything I missed.

Top pain points you reiterated:
- Search relevance/recall dropping on long-tail queries (especially clinical procedure synonyms).
- Token cost volatility across peak hours; current 3x variance month-over-month.
- Occasional hallucination in the assistant flow when prompts include patient-like identifiers.

Primary goals for the 6-week POC:
1) Improve reranking NDCG@10 by at least 12% on the 50-core evaluation set.
2) Reduce average per-request token cost by ~30% (via caching/quantized model variant).
3) Measure hallucination rate and get it under the baseline (current ~6% on flagged prompts).
4) Validate end-to-end 99th percentile latency < 300ms for the chat assistant under your expected QPS.

Proposed POC scope (what Redwood will run):
- Two endpoints: search reranker (batch + streaming debug) and chat assistant (stateful, KV cache enabled).
- Evaluation sets: 50 canonical prompts (search) + 20 edge-case prompts (safety/hallucination).
- Model variants: rdx-3b-int8 and rdx-7b-q4 as fallbacks for cost/latency tradeoffs.
- Ingested dataset: 120K clinical KB snippets (you’ll provide S3 link or share Drive).

Success metrics / measurement plan:
- Weekly automated evals against the 50-case prompt set; results in shared Drive.
- Cost delta report (per-token, per-endpoint) after week 2 and week 4.
- Manual review cohort for hallucination (20 samples/week).

Owners & roles:
- Acumen: Sarah Lin (POC lead, product), Jonah Price (data owner, shared dataset access), Priya Rao (procurement contact for contract/PO).
- Redwood: Vanessa Ortiz (account owner), Marcus Lin (technical lead — infra & model tuning), Neha Kapoor (SLA/security point).

Timeline (target):
- Week 0 (by 2026-08-28): credentials, dataset access, and SOW signed.
- Week 1: baseline runs, ingest, and initial evals.
- Week 2–4: tuning, cost/latency optimizations, weekly checkpoints.
- Week 5–6: final evals, handover, and exec readout.

Immediate access/setup items we need from Acumen:
1) Temporary S3 read access or Drive link with the KB export (preferably in JSONL).
2) A service account (email) to add to your allowlist for IPs (we’ll provide IPs).
3) Procurement contact for a short SOW/PO to clear.

Attachments: Redwood_POC_SOW_Acumen_v1.pdf (SOW draft), prompt_set_template.csv (skeleton — attached in Drive link).

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm dataset access method and Priya as procurement contact by Thursday 8/27.
- Redwood will run baseline on receipt of data and send initial results within 3 business days.
- Marcus will reach out to schedule a 30-min infra/allowlist call.

Thanks — I’ll stand up the initial project space once I have the S3/Drive link.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0127

---
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference platform for reliable, cost-aware LLM serving
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acumenhealth.com>

Cc: Jonah Price <jonah.price@acumenhealth.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@acumenhealth.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & POC setup plan — Acumen Health Tech

Vanessa —

Appreciate the clear recap and plan. This aligns with what we discussed. A few notes and clarifications:

- Dataset: we can share an S3 read-only bucket. I asked our data infra team to stage the KB export in JSONL and will send the link + IAM read role by end of day Thursday (8/27).
- Metrics: NDCG improvement target looks good; can we add recall@50 as a secondary metric? That’s important for some search scenarios.
- Hallucination review: can Redwood flag examples automatically and we’ll both review in the shared spreadsheet.
- Procurement: looping in Priya (cc). Priya — can you confirm the SOW review cadence and whether a PO is required up front?

One small scope ask from our side: can the POC include a short test of redaction rules for patient IDs (we have a small set of synthetic PII to test). If yes, please add to the prompt set.

Thanks — excited to get started.

Best,
Sarah Lin
Director of Product, Acumen Health Tech
sarah.lin@acumenhealth.com | (212) 555-0183
